item.title: From Parametric to Polar in Desmos

item.title: Juggling and Kostant’s Partition Function
item.dc:creator: Christopher R. H. Hanusa
item.description: Counting juggling sequences turns out to be the same as counting the ways to break a weight of a Lie algebra into positive roots.

item.title: Alternating Billiards
